confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on several aggregator sources with mixed dates and some disagreement, so they are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors come from booking-site snapshots and a 2026 budget guide, and are less certain. There is no direct wine-by-the-glass price, so wine_glass is inferred from the local beer price (roughly 3-4x a restaurant draft beer) and is low confidence. Cocktail is a bounded estimate from rooftop and single-venue prices, not an aggregated average. The fx value was taken from search-result summaries attributed to RBA pages and was not confirmed against the RBA F11.1 table. Third-party mid-October quotes of about 0.692-0.695 are consistent with it, so the RBA-reported figure should be verified before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors come from Nha Trang-specific aggregator data (Numbeo, Citycost, Expatistan, Budgetyourtrip, Hostelz, KAYAK, Skyscanner and a 2026 budget guide), cross-checked against Vietnam-wide budget-tier guidance. Local VND prices were converted at roughly 26,000 VND per USD.
